Congratulations! 💐 

1. Marriage registration in Israel: if you have been living in Israel continuously since you submitted a single status certificate (in the beginning of the gradual process), a new certificate should not be required in order to register the marriage. You will need an apostilled marriage certificate translated to Hebrew. By law you must register your marriage within 30 days.

2. Citizenship: you can continue with the application regardless of the marriage. If you do register the marriage, however, there are some minimal advantages like not having to show Hebrew knowledge (which is basically nothing so I wouldn't worry about that).
